app.metaDescripcion: ColdCare: IoT monitoring, thermal alerts, and traceability for temperature-sensitive medicines.

login.descripcion: Continuous monitoring, early alerts and verifiable traceability for the preservation of temperature-sensitive medicines.
login.proveedorNoDisponible: Sign-in with {{proveedor}} will be available once the OAuth provider is configured.
login.googleNoAutorizado: That Google account is not authorised. Ask an administrator to register you.
login.googleNoDisponible: Google sign-in could not be loaded. Use your email and password.
login.errorPasswordCorta: Password must be at least 8 characters.
login.errorDemasiadosIntentos: Too many failed attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
login.errorServidor: Could not reach the server. Please try again.
login.sesionCerradaRecarga: For your security, the session closes when the page reloads. Please sign in again.

detalle.riesgo_preventivo: Approaching the limit: keep an eye on the refrigerator
detalle.excursion_critica: Outside the 2–8 °C range: check the refrigerator now

ia.sinInferencia: No AI inference for this reading

dashboard.descripcion: Thermal status of the pharmaceutical refrigerator
dashboard.clasificacionIaDivergente: AI classified critical excursion, but temperature is still within 2–8 °C: no confirmed excursion.
dashboard.esperandoDetalle: The panel will update automatically once the ESP32 device publishes readings.
dashboard.graficaEtiqueta: Line chart: internal and ambient temperature for the last {{n}} readings, with the 2–8 °C storage range marked

demo.descripcionBadge: Simulated data: the application runs without a server connection
demo.accesoDetalle: Pick a role to explore the system with simulated data. No password required.

historial.sinResultados: No readings match the selected filters.
historial.rangoInvalido: The "from" date cannot be later than the "to" date.

alertas.descripcion: Alerts generated by the thermal risk classifier
alertas.conflictoEstado: This alert was already updated by someone else. The list was refreshed with its current status.
alertas.sinAlertas: No alerts on record. The refrigerator remains stable.
alertas.soloFarmaceutico: Only pharmacy technical staff can acknowledge alerts.
alertas.descripcionAccionPlaceholder: E.g. vials were relocated and the thermostat set to 5 °C
alertas.descripcionAccionAyuda: Describe what was done to correct the deviation. It is recorded in the traceability log.

trazabilidad.descripcion: Every record is digitally sealed: any tampering is detected by the system
trazabilidad.cadenaIntegraDetalle: All {{n}} records are unmodified since their creation.
trazabilidad.cadenaRotaDetalle: Record #{{n}} was altered or damaged. Notify the administrator and preserve this evidence.
trazabilidad.cadenaExplicacion: Each record's seal is referenced by the next record. Integrity verification checks these links.
trazabilidad.selloAyuda: SHA-256 cryptographic fingerprint: links this record to the previous one and makes any tampering evident
trazabilidad.cadenaComprometida: Critical tampering detected in the chain
trazabilidad.cadenaComprometidaDetalle: The system quarantined the affected block. Notify the administrator and preserve this evidence for the audit.
trazabilidad.confirmarAislar: This record will be marked as isolated and excluded from the verifiable chain. The action is audited and cannot be undone.
trazabilidad.rangoInvalido: The selected range is invalid: "from" cannot be later than "to".

checklist.nota: Based on the Good Storage Practices Manual (RM No. 132-2015/MINSA and amendments). Every save is recorded in the SHA-256 traceability chain.

items.temperatura: The refrigerator records temperature within the 2–8 °C range
items.termometro: The temperature sensor sits next to the product, not on the wall
items.registros: Today's thermal records are complete and available
items.alertasRevisadas: Pending alerts have been reviewed and addressed
items.limpieza: The refrigerator is clean and free of frost build-up
items.exclusivo: The refrigerator is used exclusively for pharmaceutical products
items.rotulado: Products are labelled with visible expiry dates
items.respaldo: A contingency plan exists for power outages

checklist.guardado: Verification recorded in the traceability chain
checklist.errorGuardar: Could not save the verification. Check your connection and try again.
checklist.observacionesPlaceholder: Record any finding, deviation or action taken during the verification.
checklist.sinRegistrarHoy: Today's verification has not been recorded yet.
checklist.avisoNoConforme: Will be recorded as “with findings”: {{faltantes}} item(s) declared non-compliant.

reportes.descripcion: Export documentary evidence for audits and inspections
reportes.notaFormatos: The CSV opens in Excel for review and printing; the JSON keeps the full technical evidence (digital seals included).
reportes.sinReporte: Set the period and generate a report to see the summary.
reportes.errorGenerar: The report could not be generated.
reportes.notaPdf: The PDF embeds the SHA-256 chain integrity verdict; it is the document presented during an inspection.
reportes.errorRangoInvertido: The start date is after the end date. Fix the period.
reportes.errorPeriodoExcesivo: The period cannot exceed {{max}} days. Split the report into shorter ranges.
reportes.errorCuota: Too many reports in a row. Wait a minute before generating again.
reportes.sinReporteDetalle: Pick a period and generate the report to see the summary and download it as PDF, CSV or JSON.

auditoria.descripcion: Critical actions recorded in the system

usuarios.descripcion: Control who can access the system and what each role can do
usuarios.errorDuplicado: A user with that email already exists.
usuarios.confirmarDesactivar: Deactivate {{nombre}}? They will no longer be able to sign in, and their identity will be hidden in reports (right to be forgotten, Law No. 29733). The audit trail remains intact.
usuarios.confirmarCambiarRol: Change {{nombre}}'s role? The change applies immediately: their next protected operation is already checked against the new role's permissions.

privacidad.descripcion: Under Law No. 29733 on Personal Data Protection, we need your explicit consent to process your data within the monitoring system. You must accept to continue; if you decline, your session will be closed.
privacidad.errorAceptar: Your consent could not be saved. Check your connection and try again.

dispositivos.descripcion: Lifecycle of the sensors registered in the system
dispositivos.confirmarBaja: Decommission device {{id}}? The reading and traceability history remains intact.
dispositivos.instalacionAviso: A location change is recorded in the history; the previous location is not lost.
dispositivos.responsableAviso: This contact receives critical excursion alerts by email and, if the SMS channel is enabled, by text message.

firmware.descripcion: Manage firmware releases and deployments (simulated, no real ESP32)
firmware.errorDuplicado: A release with that version already exists.
firmware.despliegueProgramado: Deployment scheduled. Execute it whenever you want to apply the change.
firmware.errorDowngrade: Downgrade rejected: the target version is not newer than the installed one.
firmware.errorNoEncontrado: Device or version not found. Prepare the release first.

metricasIA.descripcion: Performance evidence for the Random Forest classifier that assigns the thermal risk level (RNF-04).
metricasIA.cumpleUmbral: The model meets the required performance threshold
metricasIA.noCumpleUmbral: The model does NOT meet the required performance threshold
metricasIA.explicacionUmbral: Weighted F1 obtained: {{f1}}; minimum required by RNF-04: {{umbral}}. Cross-validation is grouped by scenario, so no two readings of the same thermal event appear in both training and test sets.
metricasIA.notaRecall: In this domain recall on “critical excursion” matters most: a false negative means a batch of medicine spoils without anyone noticing.
metricasIA.importancias: Weight of each variable in the decision
metricasIA.notaReproducibilidad: The dataset and artifact hashes allow the training run to be reproduced and confirm that the deployed model is exactly the one evaluated.
metricasIA.noEntrenado: The Random Forest model is not trained in this environment. Run the training script to generate the artifact and its metrics.
metricasIA.errorCarga: Model metrics could not be loaded.
metricasIA.consecuenciaIncumplimiento: Below the threshold, automatic classification does not support compliance decisions: excursions must be confirmed manually.

sesion.porExpirar: Your session expires in {{restante}}. Save your work.
